strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description:
The energy policy strategy, which defines how chargers are prioritized when there is not enough energy to meet demand. 
Options are:
* EVEN_SPREAD- vehicles are charged in parallel and the available power is divided evenly between them. 
When one vehicle is connected, it receives all the available power, when two vehicles are connected, each vehicle receives half the available power, and so on.
* FIFO - First in, first out – vehicles are charged according to the order they arrive at the charger, so the first vehicle to arrive gets more power than the last to arrive.

type.description:
The card type. Options are:
* RFID - A physical card is used to authorize and initiate charging sessions. In this scenario, the EV owner must swipe the RFID card on the charger.
* VIRTUAL - A virtual card  is used to authorize and initiate charging sessions. In this scenario, the EV owner uses a mobile app to start charging.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description:
The energy policy strategy, which defines how chargers are prioritized when there is not enough energy to meet demand. Options are:
* EVEN_SPREAD - vehicles are charged in parallel and the available power is divided evenly between them. 
When one vehicle is connected, it receives all the available power, when two vehicles are connected, each vehicle receives half the available power, and so on.
* FIFO - First in, first out – vehicles are charged according to the order they arrive at the charger, so the first vehicle to arrive gets more power than the last to arrive.

Also known as the charger service plan.
